title: HSE Magazine Cover
description: Front cover for an Edition OS edition — a curated, ordered collection of stories drawn from multiple platforms (Shorthand, WordPress, HSE) presented as a single issue. This is distinct from the per-story `cover` in content.schema.json, which fronts one long-form piece. A magazine cover fronts many.

issue_label.description: Small, quiet issue metadata — date, price, volume/issue number. Rendered as plain corner text, e.g. 'August 1991' or 'Vol. 167 No. 6 · June 1985'.

masthead.description: The nameplate/logotype, rendered large at the top of the cover.

logo_url.description: Wordmark image. Falls back to styled text from meta.title if omitted.

portrait.description: Foreground cutout (transparent PNG), anchored to the bottom of the cover, layered above the masthead so a tightly-cropped subject can slightly overlap it — the classic British-magazine convention.

headline.description: The single lead coverline naming this issue's top story. At most one — the cover should point to one thing, not list everything inside it.

href.description: Link to the underlying story — a Shorthand, WordPress, or HSE URL, whichever platform hosts it.
